reviews.specification:
General operation: sleep at the actor's current location, with start, continue, wake/cancel and status modes; requested duration is a positive whole number of simulation rounds, default 1 for the smallest trial. This is a bounded sleep trial, not a claim that one round equals a full night's sleep. Dependencies: the existing world clock, action/work records, local environmental checks, bodily-state rules, and forest.rest recovery/accounting. Record exact reused code references and any correction in the implementation record. Development/review waiting advances no time. Before enabling execution, inspect the existing rest handler and its real call path, blockers and vital-update ordering; fix a demonstrated implementation defect in the shared recovery path rather than adding a sleep-only bypass. If the substrate cannot represent sleeping or assess required environmental conditions, implement those minimal mechanisms in this handoff; do not display a successful sleep trial until they execute.
Prerequisites: living actor physically able to lie down and enter sleep; reachable unoccupied supporting ground at the actual current position; environmental suitability established from currently available local observations and represented exposure rules. Ordinary soil at night and no observed hazard are not proof of safety. Read temperature semantics before applying any thermal check: the supplied temperature 24.24049679 must not be presumed to be ambient temperature. No bedding, shelter, watcher or other participant is supplied. Bare-ground sleep is permitted only if actual support and exposure checks allow it. If not, report the specific unmet condition and the required physical property of bedding/shelter, not an invented available object. A nearby person provides no protection unless that person independently communicates and performs a supported action.
Costs and conservation: each completed sleeping interval costs one simulation round and occupies the actor's body, location and action channel; no simultaneous active work. No item consumption, new stock or arbitrary energy fee is introduced. Existing hunger, metabolic, exposure and other ongoing processes continue under their established rules, once per elapsed round. The owned root stack item-7-ivo-76 is neither consumed nor converted into bedding or energy by this operation. Invoke the shared recovery path at most once per completed eligible interval; apply its actual modifiers and cap, with no double recovery from a concurrent rest action. Track any bodily/material inputs required by the implemented metabolism and refuse unsupported energy creation. At the supplied energy 33.24426694, an unmodified successful rest-equivalent interval would yield 37.24426694 before other actual debits; this is a conditional prediction, not an awarded outcome. There are no invented facility bonuses.
Execution and evidence: record work ID, actor reference, current position/support reference, duration, completed intervals, awake/entering/asleep/paused/woken status, suitability results and timestamps. For each trial record pre-energy, recovery eligibility, actual recovery credit, other energy debits, post-energy and applicable caps/modifiers. A verified net-zero result must distinguish a blocked recovery, an offsetting cost and an unresolved accounting fault where evidence permits; do not infer a cause from the request. Entry and sleep require actual runtime events. Check suitability on entry and every interval; wake or pause on a detected threat, unsafe exposure, lost support, incompatible action, injury or explicit wake command as supported by the engine. Do not guarantee detection of unseen threats. No unattended full-duration advance or others' actions may be assumed.
Progress and lifecycle: only completed eligible intervals earn their actual recovery. Interruption retains completed interval history and the recorded reason, but grants no unearned partial-interval recovery. Resume requires fresh suitability checks and another actual sleep entry. Cancellation wakes the actor and ends pending work without undoing elapsed time, metabolic costs or recovery already received. Death terminates sleep immediately and invokes ordinary death/inventory rules; no post-death recovery. No escrow or material reservation is needed for bare-ground sleep, so no item refund is due. If later implementations reserve real bedding, release surviving reservations on cancellation or death without repairing wear or refunding consumed resources. Continue environmental checks and normal ongoing processes while asleep; there is no persistent protective field or maintenance-free shelter. Real outputs are completed sleep intervals, measured vital changes and retained trial observations, or an explicit blocked/interrupted outcome. Rules execute in code after implementation, not by repeated model approval.

A groove shows by its shaded floor: the ground tone darkened by 1 - 1/sqrt(1 + (2 depth / width)^2); contrast is the 0-1 colour distance, visible from 0.05. The grooves form one ground drawing nearby people see, with geometry, depth, colour, contrast, subject, strokes and status. Only performed strokes are recorded; completion means they were made, not that they look like the subject. Losing sight of the subject, reach, light or an unchanged patch pauses at no charge, as does an unworked round.
